data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Air Force Systems > Fortress Avionics
data.Finding Summary: Missing critical OT patch on maintenance server; vendor-supplied firmware patch pending validation.
data.Notes: Patch available from vendor; validation required to ensure no avionics regressions before deployment.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Air Force Systems > Fortress Avionics
data.Finding Summary: Anomalous outbound connection from jump host during non-maintenance window.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Air Force Systems > Fortress Avionics
data.Finding Summary: Configuration drift detected on sensor node; package versions differ from baseline by one minor revision.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Air Force Systems > Fortress Avionics
data.Finding Summary: Excessive DB privileges found for several maintenance accounts; accounts not scoped to least privilege.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Air Force Systems > Fortress Avionics
data.Finding Summary: Spike in latency observed for telemetry ingest pipeline indicating intermittent IO contention on DB host.

data.Finding Summary: SCADA protocol (Modbus/TCP) accessible from maintenance VLAN — insufficient micro-segmentation on ICS subnet.
data.Recommendation: Implement micro-segmentation, restrict Modbus/TCP flows to approved hosts, validate with follow-up ACAS scan.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Sustainment Operations > Defense Infrastructure Directorate
data.Finding Summary: Firewall rule allows broad SSH access from maintenance VLAN to ICS DMZ; overly permissive management access.
data.Recommendation: Tighten management access rules, restrict SSH to jump hosts and authorized admin subnets, rotate management credentials.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Sustainment Operations > Defense Infrastructure Directorate
data.Finding Summary: Oracle Database 19c has TLS cipher suites that include weak ciphers (RC4/3DES) enabled.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Sustainment Operations > Defense Infrastructure Directorate
data.Finding Summary: RHEL 8 host missing several security patches (kernel and libcrypto packages) required by STIG baseline.
data.Recommendation: Apply vendor patches during maintenance window, re-run configuration compliance scan, and update baseline artifact.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Sustainment Operations > Defense Infrastructure Directorate
data.Finding Summary: Legacy PLC firmware reports known vendor vulnerabilities; vendor-assisted scanning required for deeper analysis.
data.Recommendation: Engage vendor for safe scanning and firmware patch schedule; document compensating monitoring in POA&M until replacement.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Sustainment Operations > Defense Infrastructure Directorate
data.Finding Summary: Claroty detected anomalous PLC command patterns and high error rates from one maintenance endpoint — potential misconfiguration or reconnaissance.
data.Recommendation: Investigate source endpoint behavior, quarantine if necessary, and refine anomaly detection tuning to reduce false positives.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Sustainment Operations > Defense Infrastructure Directorate
data.Finding Summary: Database listener configuration matches approved baseline; no actionable findings.
data.Recommendation: Continue monthly baseline verification and document in SCTM.

data.Finding Description: Database node running outdated OS package with a known privilege escalation vulnerability (CVE-2024-XXXX).
data.Recommended Action: Apply vendor patch and validate configuration baseline; retest with ACAS.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Infrastructure Command > Enterprise Database
data.Finding Description: Administrative interface accessible without MFA; weak authentication configuration for several admin accounts.
data.Recommended Action: Enforce MFA via enterprise IAM for administrative accounts; remove or harden legacy administrative accounts.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Infrastructure Command > Enterprise Database
data.Finding Description: Hypervisor management tools showing default/weak credentials and outdated management agents.
data.Recommended Action: Rotate management credentials, update agents to latest vendor release, and verify via configuration scan.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Infrastructure Command > Enterprise Database
data.Finding Description: Firewall rules permit unapproved cross-zone administrative traffic from enterprise network to SCADA gateway.
data.Recommended Action: Harden firewall rules to enforce least-privilege, restrict admin ports to jump host, and re-audit ruleset.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Infrastructure Command > Enterprise Database
data.Finding Description: Device configuration drift detected: NMS differs from approved baseline in SNMP community strings and logging settings.
data.Recommended Action: Reapply approved baseline, update SNMP community strings to v3, and enable secure logging; validate with subsequent scan.

data.Organization Hierarchy: DoD > Defense Infrastructure Command > Enterprise Database
data.Finding Description: Backup target verified; backup communication channels encrypted and backup verification tasks passed.
data.Recommended Action: Continue scheduled backup verification and rotate backup encryption keys per policy.
